title: Causal Validation
description: Validates a specific reconstructed causal hypothesis using evidence checks, temporal precedence, counterfactual branches, necessity and sufficiency assessment, and competing hypotheses.

validation_id.description: Unique identifier for this causal validation record.

reconstruction_id.description: Reference to the causal reconstruction containing the hypothesis being validated.

hypothesis_id.description: Identifier of the specific candidate causal hypothesis being validated.

comparison_id.description: Optional reference to the hypothesis comparison record associated with this validation.

temporal_assessment_id.description: Reference to the temporal precedence assessment associated with the hypothesis.

necessity_sufficiency_assessment_id.description: Reference to the causal necessity and sufficiency assessment associated with the hypothesis.

evidence_checks.description: Evidence-level assessments supporting, contradicting, or otherwise informing the causal hypothesis.

counterfactual_branch_refs.description: References to structured counterfactual branches used to evaluate the hypothesis.

competing_hypothesis_refs.description: References to alternative causal hypotheses that remain relevant to the validation.

check_id.description: Unique identifier for this evidence check within the validation record.

evidence_ref.description: Reference to an evidence item from the corresponding causal observation.

rationale.description: Explanation of why the referenced evidence receives the stated assessment.

status.description: Final validation status of the causal hypothesis. Supported does not imply proven causality.

confidence.description: Confidence in the validation assessment. This value does not represent proof or a universal causal probability.

rationale.description: Overall explanation of the validation conclusion.

blocking_issues.description: Known limitations, unresolved issues, or conditions preventing stronger causal conclusions.
